_note: Level spine (spec §7). levels[].lessons lists lesson ids → content/lessons/<id>.json; gate.content points at the gate's file. Adding a lesson = a JSON file + its id here; no code change.
title: The Analyst Path

levels.label: Level 0
levels.title: Orientation
levels.summary: Cell references, ranges, typing a value vs a formula, and $ absolute references, because everything later depends on them.
levels.claimAfter: Comfortable navigating a sheet and writing basic formulas.

levels.label: Level 1
levels.title: The daily four + logic
levels.summary: SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT and COUNTA; then IF, SUMIF → SUMIFS, COUNTIF → COUNTIFS and IFERROR, including the argument-order trap and quoted criteria.
levels.claimAfter: I can summarise and conditionally aggregate transactional data.

levels.label: Level 2
levels.title: Lookups
levels.summary: VLOOKUP exact and approximate, locking the table, XLOOKUP (and its version caveat), INDEX/MATCH for reverse lookups, and lookups inside arithmetic.
levels.claimAfter: I can join tables with VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP and INDEX/MATCH, in any direction.

levels.label: Level 3
levels.title: Clean & summarise like an analyst
levels.summary: Remove duplicates, fill blanks, standardise text, fix numbers stored as text and typos; build, filter and refresh pivots; then turn the result into one chart and one sentence.

gate.label: Assignment 3: From messy export to one-slide answer

levels.claimAfter: I can take a raw export, clean it, pivot it, and communicate the finding.

levels.label: Capstone
levels.title: The mock hiring test
levels.summary: 10 tasks spanning every level, under a 45-minute countdown, auto-graded, with the answer key only after you submit. Two variants, so a retake tests skills, not memory.
levels.claimAfter: You can sit a timed, mixed Excel test and finish it correctly under time — the thing the hiring test actually measures.

cases.title: Case A: Q3 sales review for the boss
cases.summary: Clean the export, enrich it with lookups, pivot revenue by region and by rep, and write the two-sentence finding: which region carried Q3, and who is furthest behind target.
